Middleware stores sync in CouchDB and publishes async to Datahub

Long image

A

Answer

The Advanced Middleware accepts RO-Crate ARCs, writes them immediately to CouchDB, and publishes asynchronously to Datahub. The overview shows the store ports ArcStore and ConsolidatedArcStore — without concrete Git implementations.

  1. Sync path via Harvest API: POST /v3/harvests and POST /v3/harvests/{id}/arcs → CouchDB → HTTP response.1
  2. Async path: Celery syncs via ArcStore and finalizes the catalog via ConsolidatedArcStore after Harvest COMPLETED.23
  3. SearchHUB is context only: no code reference in this repository.

What is inside the Celery worker process?

Diagram structure
  • RabbitMQ rabbitmq
  • BL-Manager bl-mgr
  • Celery Tasks tasks
  • ARCtrl arctrl
  • BusinessLogic bl
  • ArcStore arcstore
  • ConsolidatedArcStore consol
  • DocumentStore docstore
  • Datahub datahub
  • rabbitmq → tasks · ARC JSON-LD / rdi
  • tasks → bl-mgr · gets instance
  • bl-mgr → bl · provides
  • tasks → bl · sync / finalize
  • bl → arctrl · from_rocrate_json_string
  • bl → arcstore · ARC object
  • bl → consol · finalize(rdi)
  • bl → docstore · writes events
  • docstore → consol · ARC JSON-LD per RDI
  • arcstore → datahub · ARC repo
  • consol → datahub · {rdi}.json

Full page: Worker process internals

  1. Celery tasks ↗

    Entry: sync_arc_to_gitlab with full ARC JSON-LD, finalize_catalog with RDI.10

  2. BL manager ↗

    Holds and provides the one BusinessLogic instance per process.11

  3. BusinessLogic ↗

    Drives sync and finalize; does not read ARCs from CouchDB itself.2

  4. ARCtrl ↗

    Core of the worker: builds the ARC object from JSON-LD.12

  5. ArcStore ↗

    Writes the ARC object as a Git repo to Datahub.4

  6. ConsolidatedArcStore ↗

    Reads an RDI’s ARCs directly from CouchDB, not via BL.13

  7. DocumentStore ↗

    Sync writes events only; finalize reads ARC content.14
